t: r/Butchery on Reddit: What would someone expect to pay for 1/2 a pig. Roughly 160-180lbs of pork with breakfast sausage, bacon, 2 hams, cudighi and your normal cuts of chops, steaks, etc…?
s: October 23, 2024 - I sell half and whole pigs, prices vary greatly depending on your area. You're not getting that much meat back for a half unless you're buying an older adult pig. For a typical 6 month old feeder pig like I sell, I shoot for a 270lb live weight.
